definitions.explanation: A record that surpasses the previous best, typically in sports, achievements, or statistics.

examples.japanese: {新記録|しんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{新記録|しんきろく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: A new world record was born.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猛暑日|もうしょび}→猛暑日：09622_moushobi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新記録|しんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: This year's extremely hot days broke the record for the most ever.

notes:
{新記録|しんきろく} refers to a record that surpasses the previous best, most commonly used in sports but also for weather, sales figures, and other measurable achievements.

ETYMOLOGY:
{新|しん} (new) + ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (record).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新記録|しんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to set a new record
- {新記録|しんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to break/update a record
- {新記録|しんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve a new record
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{新記録|しんきろく}: new world record
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{新記録|しんきろく}: new Japanese record
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧{新記録|しんきろく}: tournament record

USAGE:
Often abbreviated to {新記録|しんきろく} in headlines and sports commentary. The verb ⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧ (to update) is the standard way to say "break a record" in Japanese, rather than a direct translation of "break."
